title: CT scan of the implant arranged by an unnamed insider
summary: Whitley Strieber tells of CT scan of the implant arranged by an unnamed insider, about recent at California, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Anyway, he wants me to get a CT scan of the implant.

plain: A writer named Whitley Strieber says there is an object he calls an implant in his body, and that an unnamed insider in California wants him to get a CT scan of it. A CT scan is a detailed X-ray image of the inside of the body. He tells a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about the plan, which would matter because a scan might show what the object actually is.
